_comment: Generated with Node's crypto.subtle directly, not through the module. Not regenerable once any client has written a v1 envelope. See the README under "Regenerating the fixture" and the hash pin in golden-envelope.test.ts.

_provenance.generated: 2026-11-24, one-layer format. A throwaway Node script using crypto.subtle only, every constant copied by value: context framing, HKDF-SHA512 with the per-wrap kdfSalt and KEY_WRAP_KDF_INFO, AES-256-GCM over kB with KEY_WRAP_AAD_LABEL || context as aad. kB, prfOut, uid, credentialId and keyWrapIv are the fixed inputs carried over from the HPKE-era fixture; kdfSalt is a fixed input introduced with this format.
_provenance.independentlyVerified: 2026-11-25, vpomerleau (PR #21823). A separate crypto.subtle-only script with the constants copied by value, importing nothing from passkey-crypto: context framing, unwrap, re-encrypt to the same wrappedKb, and the FIXTURE_SHA256 pin all matched. Mutation of every field, both labels, the HKDF hash and the framing was caught.
_provenance.frozenSince: 2026-11-24, by decision (ADR 0053), before any production write
